claims.claim: LSEG's Risk Intelligence page introduces the product with 'You might know us for our World-Check screening database, but what you might not know is that we offer so much more'

LSEG describes World-Check as intelligence data used across LSEG screening solutions to help organisations identify potential sanctions, politically exposed person (PEP), adverse media, enforcement and other risk indicators
LSEG positions World-Check data inside screening solutions for KYC, sanctions screening, adverse media reviews, third-party assessments and payment verification workflows
LSEG documents LSEG World-Check Verify as a cloud-native API that uses World-Check data for selected digital onboarding and payment journeys
LSEG's screening-solutions FAQ states World-Check provides structured sanctions intelligence that organisations can use to support sanctions screening processes
Thomson Reuters announced its acquisition of World-Check on 16 May 2011 in a press release hosted on world-check.com
World-Check formed part of the Thomson Reuters Risk Management Solutions suite before being transferred to Refinitiv after a merger deal with The Blackstone Group in October 2018

Thomson Reuters sold a 55% majority stake in its Financial & Risk unit to Blackstone Group LP on October 1, 2018, valuing the business at about $20 billion, and this business was formed into Refinitiv
LSEG agreed to buy Refinitiv in an all-share transaction announced August 2019, and the acquisition was completed on 29 April 2021
LSEG said in August 2023 it intended to retire the Refinitiv name across the group
No public World-Check price list and no public profile count appear on the official LSEG Risk Intelligence page reviewed on 10 October 2026
SanctionsAI screens against the official US Treasury OFAC SDN list, synced hourly
SanctionsAI's published scope is 19,218 OFAC SDN name entries, 16 embargoed jurisdictions, and 947 sanctioned crypto wallet addresses
SanctionsAI publishes a downloadable dataset of 947 OFAC-sanctioned crypto wallet addresses, refreshed to the OFAC SDN publication of 2026-10-02 at time of review
SanctionsAI pricing is published: free for 5 checks a day with no signup and no API key, from $19/month in production
SanctionsAI is MIT licensed and self-hostable, per this site's homepage
SanctionsAI documents response latency as under 100 ms on its homepage

SanctionsAI published this page on 18 July 2026 (original template) and materially reviewed and revised it on 10 October 2026, removing the unsourced '$50,000 to $250,000 per year' pricing range, the unsourced 'over 4 million profiles across 240 countries' figure (a Dow Jones RDC figure mistakenly attributed to World-Check), the stated-as-fact 'no free tier, no developer sandbox' claim, and the 'under 5 minutes' integration claim
